content:
76c635c Add check for number of corner points in ptaConvertToBox() * also for Issue 743, in pixWriteStreamBmp() check for colormap before   referencing in DEBUG clause
ed50092 Improve extracting image compression formats from filenames and extensions. * split out extension table lookup (getFormatFromExtension()) from   getImpliedFileFormat() * add prog/scaleimages.c, for filtered scaling of images in a directory. * add JPG to extension table * fix incorrect use of lept_free() in pdfio2.c.  Use LEPT_FREE in the library. * in case there is a request to write a 24 bit pix in bmp format,   add converter from 24 to 32 bits in bmpio, as suggested by Ger Hobbelt   in PR #684 and #685
0215271 Support read/write of 4 sample/pixel rgba images in bmp format * Vlad Astakhov submitted a fix to allow reading rgba (ignoring the alpha).   Windows screengrabs apparently produce these. * Save the alpha component when reading rgba in bmp format. * For spp == 4 pix, save the alpha component when writing bmp. * Added a test section in ioformats_reg for miscellaneous tests.   In there, test write/read of rgba, including alpha, for both png and bmp.
427de3e Remove PROCNAME / procName and use __func__
e8b670d Split pix.h and array.h into a public interface and an internal interface * The internal files pix_internal.h and array_internal.h contain   definitions of the structs. * The rest is the public interface, with typedefs and flags. * Applications should use the public interface, which includes accessors   to the fields, but if necessary they can include the internal files. * Only twelve test programs in /prog require an internal file to be included. * These changes were suggested and promoted by Stefan Weil.  They are   a significant change to the ABI and will require increasing the .so   number of the library to 6.0.0.
d4ab740 Make bmpio non-support of 32-bit bmp (rgba) explicit * leptonica support for bmp files is intended to be minimal: 1,2,4,8,16   bpp with 1 component; 24 bpp for RGB; 4 byte colormaps up to 256 colors;   no compression; no transparency. * 32 bpp bmp files made by windows screen grab have transparency and are   not supported.  Use png for images with transparency. * Decision not to support 32-bit bmp files may be revised in the future.
7c42450 Fix oss-fuz issues 22377 and 22378: leaks during writing png * Make sure that colormap is valid * Also check validity for writing bmp, gif, spix
e1d5c88 Fixed oss-fuzz issue 22323: Direct-leak in pixcmapCreate() * Always attach colormap to pix, even if not valid. * Check pixSetColormap() in I/O routines where the pix and colormap   depths may differ.
6988379 Better handling of 1 bpp colormapped images.  Also: * removal of duplicated code in rotate1_reg.c * adding clear notification in reg test output when errors are expected * add some error checking (dewarp1.c, utils2.c)
002843b Yet another small restriction on bmp input data.
7a74abc More sanity-checking restrictions on input data in bmp files
50c3c35 Fix bit shift overflow in bmp reading.
bb6252d Improved sanity checking on colormap size when reading bmp files.
9540500 Modified bmpio allow reading from files with newer formats. * No longer restrict the infoheader to be 40 bytes. * Add 2 bpp bmp file to mtiff_reg test. * Addresses issue #454
4f25104 Replaced all fprintf(stderr, ...) with lept_stderr(...) in the library * This completes the stderr redirection. * Also included auto_config.h in this set of about 80 changed files
1480744 In gplot, generate the pix directly with a single call * without having to specify a rootname and then generating the   file name to read it back.  This is done changing only       gplotSimpleXY1(), ...XY2() and ... XYN()   and adding new functions that call them:       gplotSimplePix1(), gplotSimplePix2(), gplotSimplePixN() * Also, several small mods to satisfy various compilers * Also, begin adding #include <config_auto.h> to all source files.   This must be added at the top, as the first non-comment statement.   Richard Daniel also pointed out that you shouls use <> instead   of quotes to be sure to get the config file of the build system,   if there is one. * Also fixed some potential leaks found by Coverity Scan. CS has   been broken for about 6 months, but Stefan Weil was able to   load the previous version and run it.
a194247 Accommodate buggy readers that use the alpha byte with 3 bpp RGB images. * Some java tests have been trying to interpret the alpha byte for   RGB images.  We set the alpha byte to 255 (opaque), although it is   not necessary (issue #442). * Also, add caution about using orientation detector on tables (issue #466).
18abe3c Removed 'register' from the auto-generated files * 'register' declarations were deprecated as of C++-11. * modified the auto-generation software and templates to   generate proper Doxygen comments * This involved fixing 3 of the code generators (fhmtauto.c,   fmorphauto.c, stringcode.c), 5 of the templates (hmttemplate*.txt,   morphtempalte*.txt, stringtemplate1.txt), and regenerating 9 source   files of auto-genned code (dwacomb*.c, dwalinear*.c, fhmtgen*.c,   fmorphgen*.c, autogen.137.c).  Not something you want to do very often. Also: * More use of uint32 to avoid fuzzer complaints about 32 bit left shifts.   Most likely this wasn't a problem. * Removal of some unused #defines. * Increment version numbers beyond current release, to 1.79.
a2d832e Strict constraint on size of headers, colormap and data in bmp file.
ca56c4e bmp: fix handling of bitmap file header
9540500 (HEAD -> master) Modified bmpio allow reading from files with newer formats. * No longer restrict the infoheader to be 40 bytes. * Add 2 bpp bmp file to mtiff_reg test. * Addresses issue #454
